text: The old Account Hub display named its socket-security field incomingAuth even though it translated socketType. The accepted display has separate incomingSocketType and incomingAuthenticationType fields and separate translation helpers for socketType and auth. For this detail UI, recommend names that match the value’s meaning, especially when security and authentication are adjacent. The current source supports this local naming pattern; it does not establish a project-wide naming rule or reviewer approval, and live labels were not tested. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.
title: Configuration detail names distinguish transport security from authentication
